text: 很简单 都不用谈什么大道理
en: It is very simple; there is no need to discuss any grand principles.

text: 连一个劳动法都落实不了的社会 妓女的劳动成果谁来保护
en: In a society that cannot even implement a single labour law, who will protect a prostitute's labour output?

text: 那你可以想象一个社会主义国家：
en: Then you can imagine a socialist country:

text: 公务员嫖娼合法
en: Civil servants' prostitution is legal.

text: 国企员工下班兼职卖淫
en: State-owned enterprise employees moonlight as prostitutes after work.

text: 是不是非常炸裂？
en: Is that not utterly mind-blowing?

text: 只能靠意志反驳，无法靠完备逻辑反驳。
en: It can only be refuted through will, not through complete logic.

text: 一切问题最终都会被回溯至一个单一问题：
en: All problems will ultimately be traced back to a single question:

text: “人的性属性和性价值，是否具有特殊性，使得其不可被交易？
en: “Does a person's sexual nature and sexual value possess a special character that makes them impossible to trade?

text: 而这个问题对应的不同答案背后的支撑，就已经是不同的意志了，即不同的价值观和意识形态了，而不存在任何事实或真理性质的内容。
en: And the support behind the differing answers to this question already constitutes differing wills—that is, differing values and ideologies—and contains no content of any factual or truth-like nature.

text: 若你想反驳，更好的切入点，也并非是从以上这种价值高度去切入，而是从更上层的立法精神层面切入。
en: If you wish to refute it, a better point of entry is not to cut in from the height of such values as above, but to cut in from the higher plane of legislative spirit.

text: 立法的原则，是社会公益和个人权利律令之间的合理均衡。
en: The principle of legislation is a reasonable equilibrium between the public good of society and the imperative of individual rights.

text: 由此，你就将这个问题转化成了 “是否促进或破坏了社会公益最大化” 和 “个人处置自身的性价值是否属于个人核心权利和自由” 这两个问题。
en: Thereby, you transform this question into these two questions: "whether it promotes or undermines the maximisation of the public good" and "whether an individual's disposal of their own sexual value counts as a core individual right and freedom".

text: 后一个问题的答案，依然如前，只能指向意志的对抗，而并无法找到一个普适的真理或事实原点。
en: The answer to the latter question, as before, can only point to a confrontation of wills, and cannot arrive at any universal truth or factual origin.

text: 但 “社会公益最大化” 则可以展开讨论很多很多。
en: But "the maximisation of the public good" can be discussed at great length.

text: 且在讨论中，“群体道德和价值观实然现状” 可以成为一个 “事实” 而不是 “意志”，进而作为一个堆砌的原点而存在。
en: And in the discussion, the "actual present state of group morality and values" can become a "fact" rather than a "will", and thereby stand as a piled-up origin.

text: 以及，很多在执法过程中的现实问题，如组织化乃至资本化对从业者自由意志的必然侵蚀等问题，可自然将 “卖淫合法” 和 “本质是强奸” 之间建立起程度相关性，进而引用现存的 “强奸是犯罪” 来完成反驳的逻辑链。
en: And many practical problems in the course of law enforcement—such as the inevitable erosion of practitioners' free will through organisation and even capitalisation—can naturally establish a degree of correlation between "legalised prostitution" and "essentially rape", and thereby invoke the existing "rape is a crime" to complete the logical chain of refutation.

text: 而执法过程中的现实问题，本就是立法过程中的常见且合理考量。
en: And the practical problems in the course of law enforcement are themselves common and reasonable considerations in the legislative process.

text: 总之，试图在是非对错层面展开讨论，终究是徒劳的，因为最终只会存在意志原点，而不存在任何真理或事实原点。
en: In short, attempting to unfold a discussion at the level of right and wrong is ultimately futile, because in the end only a will-origin exists, and there is no truth or factual origin whatsoever.

text: 有效的讨论，仅存在于有关社会公益最大化的现实分析中，如有关婚姻家庭关系、公共卫生、违背女性自由意志乃至危害女性人身安全、经济发展动力、对社会道德实然存在的冲击、对群体建构的解构，等等。
en: Effective discussion exists only in the realistic analysis concerning the maximisation of the public good—such as regarding marital and family relations, public health, the violation of women's free will and even the endangerment of women's personal safety, the driving force of economic development, the impact upon the actually-existing social morality, the deconstruction of group formation, and so on.

text: 最后，顺便表明一下我个人对此事的态度。
en: Finally, let me take the occasion to state my personal attitude towards this matter.

text: 若更偏向于个人认定的应然方向，我倾向于支持纯个体户合法，组织性营业非法，接受服务皆合法。
en: If I lean more towards the ought-direction as I personally conceive it, I tend to support legalising pure sole proprietors, outlawing organised operations, and legalising all who receive services.

text: 而若更偏向于基于实然现实的审慎立法，我更倾向于认为我国今天的版本就挺好：从业者和接受服务者违法但非罪，组织者犯罪；确有实质的执法力度，但同时又普遍存在。
en: Whereas if I lean more towards prudent legislation grounded in actual reality, I am even more inclined to think that our country's present version is quite good: practitioners and service recipients violate the law but are not criminal, organisers commit crimes; there is genuine, substantial enforcement, yet it is also widespread.

text: 对于滑坡人，
en: As for the slippery-slope person,

text: 就用滑坡攻击他。
en: attack him with the slippery slope.

text: 1.比如他说，“如果卖淫合法，你的老婆女儿就会去卖淫。
en: 1. For example, he says, "If prostitution is legalised, your wife and daughter will go into prostitution."

text: （这种人没有逻辑能力，只听得懂最直白的话）
en: (This kind of person has no capacity for logic and only understands the most plain words.)

text: 那就直接回他：
en: Then just reply to him directly:

text: “现在出轨和包养合法，你的老婆一定在出轨，你的女儿也正在被人包养。
en: “Adultery and keeping a mistress are legal now; your wife must be having an affair, and your daughter is currently being kept as a mistress.

text: 2.他又说，”如果卖淫合法，就会有人想尽办法强迫你的老婆女儿去卖淫。
en: 2. He says again, "If prostitution is legalised, there will be people who try every means to force your wife and daughter into prostitution.

text: 直接回他：”现在当小三也是合法的，有人想办法强迫你的女儿当小三了吗？
en: Reply to him directly: "Being a mistress is also legal now; has anyone tried to force your daughter into being a mistress?

text: 知三当三一个月能拿不少钱呢。
en: Being a knowing third party can earn quite a lot of money in a month.

text: 3.比如他说，”如果卖淫合法，那么性病就会大量传播。
en: 3. For example, he says, "If prostitution is legalised, then sexually transmitted diseases will spread on a large scale."

text: （这类人明显要聪明点，这种时候就可以给对方讲道理。
en: (This type of person is clearly a bit smarter; at such a time you can reason with them.

text: 回他：”前段时间新闻报道，日本梅毒大流行，直接原因就是站街女太多了。
en: Reply to him: "A while ago the news reported a syphilis pandemic in Japan, the direct cause being too many streetwalkers."

text: 但是中国每10万人里有25.9例，日本每十万人里有10.2例。
en: But in China there are 25.9 cases per 100,000 people, and in Japan 10.2 cases per 100,000 people.

text: （注意：中国的“发病率”统计包含了I、II、III期梅毒和隐性梅毒，而许多国家主要报告具有传染性的I期和II期梅毒。
en: (Note: China's "incidence rate" statistics include stage I, II and III syphilis and latent syphilis, whereas many countries mainly report the infectious stage I and stage II syphilis.

text: 这使得直接比较发病率数字时需要谨慎。
en: This means one must exercise caution when directly comparing incidence-rate figures.

text: 那么性病传播，是因为某些群体的大规模危险性行为，而非卖淫产业的存在与否。
en: Thus the spread of sexually transmitted diseases is due to the large-scale risky sexual behaviour of certain groups, not the existence or otherwise of the prostitution industry.

text: 4.比如他说，“如果卖淫合法，那么黄赌毒不分家，黑社会组织就会兴盛。
en: 4. For example, he says, "If prostitution is legalised, then vice, gambling and drugs will not be separated, and organised crime syndicates will flourish."

text: (这类人也可以讲道理）
en: (This type of person can also be reasoned with.)

text: 回他：”中国从90年代到08年左右，治安环境显著提升，是因为加入了wto，年轻人就业率上升，同时国家财政丰盈，支撑的起各项扫黑除恶活动。
en: Reply to him: "From the 1990s to around 2008, China's public security environment improved markedly because it joined the WTO, young people's employment rate rose, and at the same time state finances were abundant enough to sustain all sorts of crackdowns on organised crime and evil forces."

text: 根除黑社会组织，是多方面因素共同作用的结果（经济发展是主因）。
en: Eradicating organised crime syndicates is the result of multiple factors acting together (economic development being the main cause).

text: 最后，提一句，卖淫的本质是剥削，不是什么好东西。
en: Finally, let me add one point: the essence of prostitution is exploitation; it is not a good thing.

text: 但是凭什么女性被剥削，是剥削。
en: But why is it that when women are exploited, it counts as exploitation,

en: while the blood and tears shed by men can be ignored as though they did not exist?

en: And a bride price of 380,000—how many years of toil is that for an ordinary family?

en: Jokes aside, let me speak seriously for a few words on why prostitution cannot be legalised.

text: 原因很简单，与“黄赌毒”沾边的东西，合法化只有“国营”一条路。
en: The reason is simple: for anything touching "vice, gambling and drugs", legalisation has only one path—"state operation".

en: Since ancient times, what most stimulates human dopamine is "vice, gambling and drugs"; once completely liberalised, folk wisdom will devise all sorts of variations.

en: 9,998 yuan a night, 99,998 yuan a night, 199,998 yuan a night—all in short supply; what kind of scene is this?

en: Moreover, all sorts of borderline businesses will inevitably spring up.

text: 比如，你卖淫都合法了，脱衣舞合不合法？
en: For example, if prostitution is legal, is striptease legal?

en: After all, striptease is merely the foreplay of prostitution.

en: Everything will become bizarre and motley, both absurd and manifest.

en: Even "Behind vermilion gates wine and meat rot, while on the road lie those frozen to death" feels lacking in imagination.

en: Moreover, for this thing to be state-run and monopolise is even more a fool's daydream.

en: The reason oil is so thoroughly state-run is that oil does not grow on people's bodies.

en: Underground brothels will inevitably blossom everywhere, and upon the ensuing grey industrial chain many parasites will appear.

en: In short, this is an industry that cannot be fully regulated.

en: Even in Europe and America, gangs and human trafficking are closely bound up with this industry.

text: 觉得卖淫可以合法化的，明显把事情看得过于简单，殊不知，有些东西像潘多拉魔盒，一旦打开，想关上就没那么容易了。
en: Those who think prostitution can be legalised clearly see things too simply; little do they know that some things are like Pandora's box—once opened, it is not so easy to close.

text: 二更
en: Second update

text: 评论区反对意见我看了，大致分两种：
en: I have read the opposing views in the comments section; they roughly fall into two kinds:

en: “Foreign countries legalised it, yet we haven't seen the situations you described.”

en: “Do you think these situations wouldn't exist without legalisation?”

text: 我建议这两批人自己先打一架再说
en: I suggest these two groups first have a fight among themselves before anything else.
